svg.title: APC ladder example – step transition S3 → S4 and output LiftUpValve in Delta and Siemens notation
svg.text: Ladder example – one step transition (S3 lift → S4 rotate) and one output coil, Delta and Siemens side by side
Same logic, two notations. Read from left to right: power flows through closed contacts to the coils on the right rail.
Output LiftUpValve – one coil, interlocked with LiftDownValve
Delta instruction list (IL), generated from the rungs
ANI Y0.1 // never with lift down
// %Q20.1 in the last line is the value of the
// PREVIOUS scan (written later in the program)
// = normal and wanted for an interlock.
–| |– normally open contact (TRUE when the signal is 1) –|/|– normally closed contact (TRUE when 0)
Delta: SET / RST instructions, M bits, X / Y I/O.
Siemens: –(S)– / –(R)– coils, bits in a global DB ("DB_Apc"), %I / %Q I/O.
Guide 36 – PLC ladder program of the APC
